properties.name: SelfRegistration.Enable
properties.description: Allow user's to self register to the system.

properties.name: SelfRegistration.LockOnCreation
properties.description: Lock self registered user account until e-mail verification.

properties.name: SelfRegistration.OTP.SendOTPInEmail
properties.description: Enable to send OTP in verification e-mail instead of confirmation code.

properties.name: SelfRegistration.EmailOTP.Enable
properties.description: Enable to send email OTP for self registration.

properties.name: SelfRegistration.OTP.UseUppercaseCharactersInOTP
properties.description: Enable to include uppercase characters in SMS and e-mail OTPs.

properties.name: SelfRegistration.OTP.UseLowercaseCharactersInOTP
properties.description: Enable to include lowercase characters in SMS and e-mail OTPs.

properties.name: SelfRegistration.OTP.UseNumbersInOTP
properties.description: Enable to include numbers in SMS and e-mail OTPs.

properties.name: SelfRegistration.OTP.OTPLength
properties.description: Length of the OTP for SMS and e-mail verifications. OTP length must be 4-10.

properties.name: SelfRegistration.SendConfirmationOnCreation
properties.description: Enable user account confirmation when the user account is not locked on creation

properties.name: SelfRegistration.ShowUsernameUnavailability
properties.description: Show a descriptive error message to the user if the username is already taken. However, this may lead to username enumeration

properties.name: SelfRegistration.Notification.InternallyManage
properties.description: Disable if the client application handles notification sending

properties.name: SelfRegistration.ReCaptcha
properties.description: Enable reCaptcha verification during self registration.

properties.name: SelfRegistration.VerificationCode.ExpiryTime
properties.displayName: User self registration verification link expiry time
properties.description: Specify the expiry time in minutes for the verification link.

properties.name: SelfRegistration.VerificationCode.SMSOTP.ExpiryTime
properties.displayName: User self registration SMS OTP expiry time
properties.description: Specify the expiry time in minutes for the SMS OTP.

properties.name: SelfRegistration.SMSOTP.Regex
properties.displayName: User self registration SMS OTP regex
properties.description: Regex for SMS OTP in format [allowed characters]{length}. Supported character ranges are a-z, A-Z, 0-9. Minimum OTP length is 4

properties.name: SelfRegistration.CallbackRegex
properties.displayName: User self registration callback URL regex
properties.description: This prefix will be used to validate the callback URL.

properties.name: _url_listPurposeSelfSignUp
properties.description: Click here to manage Self-Sign-Up purposes

properties.name: SelfRegistration.NotifyAccountConfirmation
properties.description: Enable sending notification for self sign up confirmation.

properties.name: SelfRegistration.ResendConfirmationReCaptcha
properties.description: Prompt reCaptcha verification for resend confirmation

properties.name: SelfRegistration.AutoLogin.Enable
properties.displayName: Enable Auto Login After Account Confirmation
properties.description: User will be logged in automatically after completing the Account Confirmation

properties.name: SelfRegistration.AutoLogin.AliasName
properties.displayName: Alias of the key used to sign to cookie
properties.description: Alias of the key used to sign to cookie. The public key has to be imported to the keystore.

properties.name: SelfRegistration.EnableDynamicPortal
properties.description: Enable and allow users to register to the system using the dynamic registration portal.
